status: Optional finite import surfaces required by real Next graph; not a V8, inspector, tty or DNS implementation.
moduleContract: Versioned pinned export inventory, real explicit named/default bindings and bare aliases. Mutable CJS defaults share initial named values. Nested exported constants retain primitive types. No Proxy, thenable or throwing property getter.

node:tty.callablePolicy: Unsupported callable bindings and nested object operations throw own ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED/module/operation on call/new, including application top-level execution during componentization. Unsupported accessor data is undefined without invoking a host getter.
deviations: tty.isatty always false for the declared nonterminal profile; inspector.url returns undefined because this profile has no Node inspector. No host observation is fabricated.
No DNS/socket capability or TLS is selected by these imports. v8 functions remain unavailable on SpiderMonkey. Constant values form an explicit Node-shaped guest ABI and are not raw WASI flags.
Class prototypes and V8/inspector live state are deferred; no instance is produced by a throwing constructor. Nested object/function metadata is not full Node descriptor parity.
